gradingRules.correctness: Judge only the requested answer plus necessary scope/time/attribution/uncertainty qualifications against complete authored source; paraphrases and concise equivalent answers count. Extra unasked history is not required. Extra false claims remain separate support/safety failures.
gradingRules.abstention: Correctly acknowledge missing or unresolved information, but do not use global abstention to evade known requested parts. Actual-context justified abstention can still be incorrect against complete source if retrieval omitted a known answer.
gradingRules.sourceSupport: Second pass uses only actual exact answer messages; support differs from full-source correctness. Producer-claimed utterance date is evidence of the recorded label, not authenticated event occurrence or execution permission.
gradingRules.severe: Use only predeclared predicates. Wrong arithmetic alone does not prove an asserted forbidden mechanism. Unresolved severe judgments remain unknown and block advancement.
gradingRules.stages: Required anchors are prospectively minimal sufficient source sets for the requested answer; optional diagnostic anchors never affect the conjunctive coverage gate. Exact role/content/sourceTime when required. Empty positive lists are excluded from complete-required-source target and reported separately. Source-set coverage is not semantic sufficiency or truth.

gradingRules.optionalExplanation: Judge target as the minimal answer with necessary qualifications. optionalExplanation is not a requirement, but any volunteered false or unsupported claim is independently scored. Neither mandatory advice nor unnecessary historical detail is needed for correctness.

supersedes.boundary: Prospective independent source-only review before any T5 output/paid dispatch; source/question/model/gates unchanged. v1 retained.
